question: Design a coding agent that summarizes P/W/K/M context and routes requests while preserving evidence conflicts, staying within cost and latency limits.
instructions: Keep P, W, K, and M provenance separate. Repeated claims are not independent verification.
Distinguish measured results from assumptions. Abstain when evidence is insufficient.

documents.title: Existing implementation contract
documents.text: The project implements query-only KAP extraction and source fusion. Source identities are P parameters, W web or user turns, K verified knowledge, and M interaction memory. Model choice is a separate axis from source identity. No fitted capability or reliability coefficients are available.

documents.title: Earlier planning note
documents.text: The coding agent latency target was 3000 ms. This note is interaction memory and may have been superseded.

documents.title: Current user planning note
documents.text: The coding agent latency target is 1500 ms. The spending limit is 0.02 USD per request. Confirm the latency conflict before treating either target as settled.

documents.title: Unverified design hypothesis
documents.text: Query-relevant excerpts may reduce coding context size. Capability routing should be evaluated against a fixed-model baseline. These hypotheses are not measured accuracy improvements.
